claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as inverter, panels, charge controllers etc.
claims.evidence: Business reputation/catalog claim; no photo can confirm a company's product range.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows only two solar panels leaning against a wall; no battery is visible in any photo, so this claim does not match the item identified.

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's claim (battery) and witnessed item (solar panels) suggests either a copy-pasted generic ad or a bait-and-switch listing.
risks.proof: A fresh photo/video of the actual item for sale with a battery (if one exists) clearly shown alongside the panels, and a seller clarification of what exactly is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Treat the battery claim as inapplicable/non-existent; price only the two panels as seen.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/voltage rating of panels, which drives most of the price.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker on the back of each panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price at lowest plausible wattage tier for panels of this visible size.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of each panel's surface in bright light, plus an electroluminescence or multimeter output test clip.

risks.risk: No visibility of junction box, back frame, or connectors (MC4 cables).
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of each panel showing junction box and cable ends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if connectors/junction box may need replacement.

risks.risk: No proof of actual power output under load.
risks.proof: Video of panel connected to a load/multimeter in sunlight showing voltage and current readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified output, worst-case low performance.

risks.risk: Age/usage history unknown, could be heavily used or salvaged.
risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, warranty card, or serial number photo matched to manufacture date.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating label on the back of each panel (wattage, voltage, current).
Photo of the rear/junction box and connector cables on each panel.
Video of the panels producing voltage/current under sunlight with a multimeter.
Clarification from seller on whether a battery is actually included, with a photo of that battery if so.
Close-up shots of cell surfaces for crack/hotspot inspection.
response.reason: The seller's detailed claim is about a battery's charge life, but the witness only saw two solar panels with no battery present, a mismatch that signals a possibly copy-pasted or bait-and-switch listing rather than a genuine description of the pictured item.
